column1: # Japanese texts made by the port (machine translation, not from the Japanese disc): the texts the Japanese game does not have
# and that the Colosseum-style screens need. Read by games/xd/tools/xd_languages_jp_gen.py (-> xd_languages_jp_texts.inc, compiled into xd_languages).
# id <TAB> kind <TAB> text.  kind: D = dialogue / menu text (every character must be in fonts 0 and 1 of the Japanese main.dol),
# L = label (kana only: the label fonts 2 / 3 / 4), K = kept as the USA text on purpose (no words), C = the Japanese bank's own text of
# the id after @ (the Japanese game has these classes under other ids).
# Text: {HH} or {HH:args} = a control code as in the USA text (HH hex; {00} = new line); {04}kanji{05}reading{06} = ruby.
# The build checks that every control code of the USA text is still there and that every character exists in its font.
